ComponentIn.title: ComponentIn
ComponentIn.description: An existing item (product_id) or a new one (name). The price is its own selling price.

ConvertStockIn.title: ConvertStockIn
ConvertStockIn.description:
Move stock already on hand (e.g. an old 'Sufuria(1-5)' item) into a set's components. The
total cost moves with it, re-shared across the components by selling price.

ProductUpdate.title: ProductUpdate
ProductUpdate.description:
Descriptive fields only. Price goes through PUT /products/{id}/pricing; cost only changes
through stock postings.

ReceiveCreate.title: ReceiveCreate
ReceiveCreate.description: Stock arriving: one item, or a bulk order sharing one transport payment.

ReceiveItem.title: ReceiveItem
ReceiveItem.description:
An existing product (by id), a set (by id), or a name. A name matching a set receives the
set; a name not yet in the shop creates the product.

For a set, qty is the number of sets and bp_cents the price paid per set: every component is
stocked, with the set's cost shared across them by selling price.

RecurringUpdate.title: RecurringUpdate
RecurringUpdate.description: Amount, account and on/off can change. To change the schedule, create a new one.

ReshareOut.title: ReshareOut
ReshareOut.description: The set's stock on hand keeps its total cost, re-shared across the items by price.

SettingsUpdate.title: SettingsUpdate
SettingsUpdate.description: Fractions are 0-1 (0.10 = 10%), with at most 4 decimal places.

SetupOut.title: SetupOut
SetupOut.description: What the sign-in screen needs before anyone is signed in.
